name: phone-sheet
title: Phone Sheet
description: What turns a menu's, a popover's or a select's popup into a sheet from the bottom on a phone (narrower than 640px), for dropdown-menu, context-menu, popover and select: the positioner pinned along the bottom of the screen, the popup across it up to 6rem below its top and clear of the home indicator, a scrim that closes it when tapped, a header with a handle that closes it when dragged down a quarter of its height or flicked, and an optional title, and rows 44px tall (`in-data-phone-sheet:`).
